input.quote: Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnity clause: Section 20 is absent entirely, yet Section 9.3 cross-references "Section 20.5" for IP-infringement remedies, Section 19.4 preserves remedies for "indemnified claims", Section 21.3 excludes "indemnification obligations" from the liability cap, and Section 30.5 refers to "an indemnified party" and "vested indemnity rights". No Vendor IP or misconduct indemnity exists anywhere, which is walk-away territory under the rule. We inserted the preferred Vendor indemnity as new Section 20.1 after Section 19.5 (the missing Section 20 slot). We targeted preferred rather than fallback because the fallback 3x-annual-fees super-cap would be a step down from Section 21.3, which currently leaves indemnification obligations outside the liability cap; we therefore did not add a super-cap or the procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, which are fallback-only elements.

proposal.summary: Insert missing Vendor indemnity (Section 20) covering IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow Customer indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity section at all (Sections 9.3 and 21.3 already assume one), so we have inserted our preferred Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP, breach-of-law, data-breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct claims, with the usual notice, control, and cooperation mechanics, and kept any Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall give Vendor prompt written notice of the claim, Vendor shall control the defence of the claim, and Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation. Customer's indemnity obligations under this Agreement, if any, are limited to third-party claims arising out of Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.
